name: Lucide Icons
summary: Browsable catalog of the Lucide SVG icon set with category filters, counts and a customizer for stroke and color.
description: The icons page of lucide.dev: the whole Lucide set in one browsable list with category counts (Arrows 218, Coding & development 271, Design 169, Devices 189, File icons 170, Accessibility 34 …), a customizer for size, stroke width and color, an option to include external libraries and a view switcher.
